name: Yolo Group S.p.A.
summary: Established in 2017 and headquartered in Milan, Italy, Yolo Group S.p.A. delivers digital insurance solutions to both individual consumers and small to medium-sized enterprises throughout Italy. For private clientele, the company offers a diverse range of coverage, including policies for sports, pets, homes, health, travel, mobility, and automobiles. Corporate clients, on the other hand, can access products such as multirisk, legal protection, professional liability, and cyber insurance. Furthermore, Yolo Group operates a dedicated Insurtech platform that empowers businesses to efficiently manage their insurance policies.
